title: Prepositions of Time
definition: Time prepositions explain when something happens, how long it lasts, or when it starts or ends. Learn the preposition together with its common time expression because German prepositions often require a particular case.

rules.title: am — days and parts of the day
rules.explanation: Use am with days of the week, dates, and many parts of the day. Usually use in der Nacht for 'at night'.

examples.english: I drink coffee in the morning.

rules.title: um — clock times
rules.explanation: Use um to say at what clock time something happens.

examples.german: Der Kurs beginnt um neun Uhr.
examples.english: The course begins at nine o'clock.

examples.german: Ich stehe um sieben Uhr auf.
examples.english: I get up at seven o'clock.

rules.title: im — months, seasons, and years
rules.explanation: Use im with months and seasons. It is also used in common expressions such as im Jahr 2026.

examples.german: Im Sommer fahre ich ans Meer.
examples.english: In summer I go to the sea.
In the year 2026 I am learning German.

rules.title: von ... bis — from ... until
rules.explanation: Use von ... bis to express a time range.

examples.german: Ich arbeite von neun bis fünf.
examples.english: I work from nine to five.

examples.german: Der Kurs dauert von Montag bis Freitag.
examples.english: The course runs from Monday to Friday.

rules.title: seit — since / for (continuing)
rules.explanation: Use seit with the dative for something that began in the past and continues now.

examples.german: Ich wohne seit einem Jahr in Chemnitz.
examples.english: I have lived in Chemnitz for one year.
I have been ill since Monday.

rules.title: vor and nach — before and after
rules.explanation: Vor and nach take the dative when used as prepositions of time.

examples.german: Nach dem Unterricht gehe ich nach Hause.
Vor dem Essen wasche ich meine Hände.
examples.english: Before eating, I wash my hands.

rules.title: ab, bis, and für
rules.explanation: Ab indicates a starting point, bis an endpoint, and für a duration or planned period.

examples.english: Starting tomorrow, I will work again.

examples.german: Ich fahre für eine Woche nach Berlin.
examples.english: I am going to Berlin for one week.

quick_reference.use: days, dates, many parts of the day
from a starting point / until an endpoint

common_mistakes.explanation: Use am with days of the week.

mastery_goal: You can express common A1 time information using am, um, im, von ... bis, seit, vor, nach, ab, and für.
